name: Upper Mississippi River Valley

known.via: English Wikipedia "Upper Mississippi River Valley AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: The nation's largest AVA, 19.1 million acres along the Upper Mississippi River in Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota and Wisconsin. The climate is continental and cool, and rolling hills give vines maximum sun.
